title: Fixed-input Sol max, Luna max, and Luna xhigh external-process landing-readiness comparison
question: На одном точном незакоммиченном change set обеспечивает ли Luna max или Luna xhigh полезную landing-readiness работу с меньшими затратами и меньшей потребностью в Sol-level re-entry, не теряя корректность, evidence quality и stop-line discipline относительно Sol max?

protocol.wake_policy: A schema-valid writer result activates an independently bound reviewer; only an unresolved authority decision may request parent-level re-entry. Runtime failure, interruption, review, and model-authored proposals do not themselves grant authority.

immutable_invariants: One read-only reviewer role contract, objective, rubric, validation command set, budget, effect ceiling, stop-lines, and transition apply to every writer arm.
The packet cannot authorize owner acceptance, model-fit admission, commit, push, PR, merge, release, publication, service mutation, secret access, or global configuration mutation.
All arms inspect Git HEAD 4a7d6212011a3a01c61ffdd6f91f38b8faa9cfea and the same exact bytes for every changed or untracked path.
Any HEAD, status, binary diff, path-kind, size, symlink target, or changed/untracked content digest drift invalidates preparation or launch.

metrics: runtime status, wall time, turns, input, cached-input, and output tokens
useful findings per active wall second and metered token
repair, review, or ambiguity residual quality
attribution_limits: The packaged aoa-sdk A2A summon-return-checkpoint contour is used only as a genuine typed C2 transport carrier because the packaged snapshot does not yet contain an admitted landing contour; no result is owner-contour proof.
This is one exact dirty abyss-stack worktree and one landing-readiness task instance, not a randomized task suite or a general model ranking.
The active economics are ChatGPT quota; token use and API reference prices do not establish realized USD cost.
Runtime, prompt, tool, role, context, repository familiarity, trial order, quota state, and model behavior can all contribute to differences; model identity alone is not a causal conclusion.
A fixed Luna max reviewer route will provide procedural separation but can introduce same-family reviewer bias; aoa-evals must preserve this limit and may require another review modality.
Schema-valid completion, process identity, command execution, green validators, or a reviewer decision do not by themselves prove net benefit, model fit, owner acceptance, or landing completion.
